text: wso does every single prop have to relearn about how to sit on a heightfield properly? these are nice btw, but im trying to put a radio tower on a hill and it isnt showing up. it looks like it will place but then i palce it and it is not there
resolution: NOT a per-prop heightfield problem — one filter bug. The iso pane's floor-cutaway (hide everything above the active storey) compared each piece's terrain-LIFTED absolute y against the (level+1)*3m cut plane, so any piece seated on a painted hill taller than ~3m hid itself the instant it committed — the ghost previews fine because ghosts aren't in the visible list, hence 'looks like it will place then it is not there'. The radio tower was just the first thing placed on a tall hill. Fixed by cutting terrain-relative: p.y - groundTopAt(p.x,p.z) < cut, so a hilltop is still floor 0 up there; raycast/snap read the same list, so hill pieces are also grabbable again. Every prop and build piece shares this one filter — nothing per-kind. Hot reload picks it up, no rebuild.
